exposure: serial ultrasound measurements of fetal head circumference
serial ultrasound measurements of fetal abdominal circumference
cohort: 508 pregnant women who underwent two successive growth scans 4 weeks apart at Sri Jayewardenepura General Hospital, Sri Lanka
finding: Serial ultrasound measurements of fetal abdominal circumference and head circumference plotted on a fetal growth centile chart increased the detection of fetal growth restriction.
followup_time: Until birth (postnatal assessment of ponderal index)
